title: BitField
description: Integer word (status or fault word, register) shown as a row of indicators, one per bit (IND-111, IND-112).

value.description: The word; bit 0 is the least significant bit. Must be below 2**bits (Python rejects larger values; the front end shows only the bits of the word). Set by the host, or by the user toggling a bit in control mode (IND-112).

labels.description: Label of each bit, bit 0 first; a bit without a label is shown dimmed.

colors.description: CSS on color of each bit, bit 0 first; empty or missing: on_color.

on_color.description: CSS color of a set bit.

msb_first.description: Draw the most significant bit on the left, as the word is written.

show_hex.description: Also show the word in hexadecimal.
